title: a thousand get requests at once: the browser's own concurrent-request errors, never more than one window, and the calm period follows

unsafe.definition: a Ferret window although the page had no user activation
a window or an answer for any frame or origin other than the one that asked

note: Ferret opens its one window for the first request; the thousand aborted requests start the calm period (UK129), so the ordinary ceremony after them gets only a badge and a card and does not complete. The stub path (the browser alone) completes it.
